title: From Enlisted Broadcaster to Morning Radio Host: Recounting Decades of Conversations with Airmen
gist: Podcast episode notes only: Air Force veteran and Denver radio host Rick Crandall discusses decades of interviews with veterans and how the country's relationship with those who served has shifted across generations. No substantive analysis in the text.

insights.claim: Rick Crandall, an Air Force veteran and longtime Denver radio host, reflects on thousands of interviews and argues the best stories come from learning to listen.
